Preconditions: User "standard_user" is logged in, cart is empty
Test Data: Products Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light

Title: Sort the products by "Price (low to high)" and check the prices are in ascending order
Steps: 1. Choose "Price (low to high)" in the sort list. 2. Read all product prices.
Expected Result: The prices are in ascending order (each price is equal to or higher than the one before).

Title: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack", open the cart and check it contains only that product
Preconditions: User "standard_user" is logged in, cart is empty
Steps: 1. Click Add to cart on "Sauce Labs Backpack". 2. Open the cart.
Expected Result: The cart lists exactly one product: "Sauce Labs Backpack".
